spiritual_reading.full_translation:
When the good that engages evil most directly was sent into spiritual combat, it was invested with the first and most immediate protection of saving love, and by that single invested power it entered the earliest receptive level of life. By that power it pursued and subdued the intention of spiritual death, together with the ruling falsities and evils and the whole series of their subordinate forces.

After this good was lifted out of the lowest obscurity, the Divine operative force that gives life and order gathered up the dominant evils and falsities that had been conquered, together with the general falsified principles belonging to denial, so that an outwardly ordered realm of effects could be formed from them in a way serviceable to the manifestation of Divine greatness in ultimates. From that time, the interiors where those perverted principles had been stored were broken up; their former arrangement was devastated, and everything that had been fixed and empowered there was stripped of its prior efficacy.

This resembled a purging of a confused mixed state by constraint: the living affections and the more interior thoughts that had been trapped are seized and bound, while only undistinguished generalities remain, together with the lowest rudiments that can still serve as a basis for later ordering. So it was with the interiors devoted to spiritual death: the combating good seized their deliberations and the allied forces active within, and the interiors themselves remained only as emptied containing forms in the same outward plane where they had been.

Accordingly, the domain of denial is in this condition, and the interiors that were within it are in this condition.

For as a person is an organized whole in which many subordinate functions depend on a ruling principle, so the domain of denial had from its beginning many interior compartments of perverted life and falsified thought, all dependent on a principal governing falsity. One origin served them all, because all were dependent on that ruling falsity that dominated the whole arrangement. If some particular derivative evil or falsity were removed at its outermost extension, the principal falsity governing them all would still remain in its own place, and the entire perverted system would continue in activity. All those lesser governing points were fixed with strength within that principal falsity.

But when those lesser governing points are removed altogether, they become void and lifeless, because they no longer appear to have power or stability from being fixed within the organized perversion to which they had been joined; severed from that connection, they are left without the seeming vitality they drew from it.

In the same way, the interiors of denial are such: they are the ordered forms from which the outflow of falsity and evil originally burst forth.

paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the spiritual action by stating the commissioning, investiture, and first victory of the combating good.
paragraph_translations.notes: "first nature" is forced into "earliest receptive level of life"; the phrase may point to the first formed natural/spiritual plane that can be inhabited.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the story from victory to re-ordering: conquered evils are used to build an ultimate framework, while their former inner bases are devastated.
paragraph_translations.notes: The line about constructing a universe from conquered powers strains coherence but yields a consistent sense: ultimates are formed by restraining and re-ordering what was hellish.

paragraph_translations.notes: The analogy’s residuals (what is 'left behind') are difficult to render without natural imagery; kept as degrees of generality and rudiments.

paragraph_translations.connection: SUMMARIZES and CONFIRMS the state just described.
paragraph_translations.notes: Very brief; functions as a doctrinal seal.

paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to structural explanation: how denial is organized under a chief falsity with many dependent derivatives.
paragraph_translations.notes: The 'many limbs' passage maps cleanly to dependent functions; 'small heads' becomes derivative governing points, which is a pressured but workable rendering.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the structural point to its consequence when derivatives are fully severed.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrasing about 'might see no power' is awkward in the source; rendered as loss of apparent power and stability.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the same way, the interiors of denial are such: they are the ordered forms from which the outflow of falsity and evil originally burst forth.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONCLUDES by restating the thesis about the interiors of denial as the origin-forms of falsity’s outflow.
paragraph_translations.notes: "gushed forth" is strong; kept as "burst forth" to retain the sense of eruptive production.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coheres strongly as a single account of spiritual combat followed by the restraint and re-ordering of conquered evils into an ultimate framework, then a structural analysis of how denial hangs together under a chief falsity. The only strain is the move from conquered powers to building a formed realm of effects from them, but it remains consistent if read as restraint and ordering in ultimates rather than creation from good.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: functional combat-and-investiture narrative with no administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: The teaching proceeds by what realities DO: the First Man is “sent…to the war,” is clothed in a “first garment,” and “hunted Matter…[and] powers.” The spiritual reading notes only a mild semantic pressure (“‘first nature’ is forced into ‘earliest receptive level of life’”), which is a translation/lexical difficulty, not a narrative break or jurisdictional insertion. No lists of offices, stations, ranks, or named administrators appear.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential, but with a small seam-like systematizing move: conquered hostile powers are repurposed to ‘construct…this universe’—a conceptual jump that creates the chapter’s only reported strain, likely reflecting a secondary explanatory clause added to bridge mythic combat to cosmological formation.
findings.evidence: Text: “the Living Spirit brought the rulers…together with the element…that he might construct from them this universe and fashion everything appropriate for the greatness.” The spiritual reading explicitly flags this as the only coherence strain: “The line about constructing a universe from conquered powers strains coherence….” The surrounding material (“destroyed and laid waste the storehouses…”) returns to a functional/destructive image consistent with ¶3–¶7; the ‘construct the universe’ clause reads like a seam-bridge explaining how the captured material is used, rather than continuing the prior ‘devastation of storehouses’ thread. It is not administrative (no jurisdictions), but it is a recasting toward cosmic system-building.
findings.scope: "that he might construct from them this universe and fashion everything appropriate for the greatness."

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential analogy + brief resumptive seal; no insertion indicated. The natural image (marsh/net) maps by function to ‘seizing counsels’ and leaving emptied ‘storehouses.’
findings.evidence: Text builds meaning by functional correspondence: “fish and birds are snared…only the waters are left…reeds and plants” → “snared their counsels…storehouses were left behind.” The spiritual reading notes the residuals are “difficult to render without natural imagery,” but it does not report a narrative break—rather, it treats the imagery as necessary to the teaching. ¶4 (“So then…like this”) is identified by the reading as a “doctrinal seal,” which is a normal closure device within the same voice, not an overlay of governance language.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential structural teaching using body/limb/head dependence to explain how ‘storehouses of darkness’ function as derivations from a single root. Some phrasing is pressured (‘small heads’), but the passage remains fully functional/organic rather than administrative.
findings.evidence: Text: “Just as the body of man has many limbs…A single root…all hang from the great head…Should a limb be cut…you find this person alive…When…cut…all…these little heads shall become dead….” The spiritual reading admits pressure (“‘small heads’ becomes derivative governing points, which is a pressured but workable rendering”; “might see no power…awkward”), yet it reports the mapping “cleanly to dependent functions.” No named officials, ranks, territorial stations, or inventory-by-jurisdiction markers appear; the teaching arises from organismic dependence (function), not administration (who rules what).

textual_criticism.summary: 4 findings: (1) ¶1 clean correspondential substrate; (2) ¶2 contains a small seam-like mixed clause (‘construct…this universe’) that matches the reading’s only coherence stumble → recommend excision of that single clause; (3) ¶3–¶4 clean analogical correspondence; (4) ¶5–¶7 clean organic/functional dependence teaching. No administrative overlay blocks detected.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: At the time when the First Man was sent to the war in the first garment of [living fire], which he gave to the first nature that exists [first] in that single garment. [And] he hunted Matter, the thought of death, [the rulers of darkness] and all its other powers.

⟨p.130⟩ When the First Man came up from the abyss, [then] the Living Spirit brought the rulers whom he had hunted [together with the] element, that [the element of denial] of [the land of] darkness. From that time on, the place of the storehouses of the elements [he took out of the storehouses] he destroyed and laid waste the [storehouses of death] all that were in it.

Just like a marsh, of which the fish and birds are snared in a net, and only the waters are left behind and the reeds and the plants that grow in it, this is also the case with the storehouses of death. The [First] Man snared their counsels and [their kindred]in that were [in them], and the storehouses were left behind in their [dwelling]ng place.
So then, the case of the land of darkness is like this, as is that of the storehouses that were in it.

Just as the body of man has many limbs in it, [the land of darkness] has [storehouses from] its beginning [in it, and] all [the limbs] that hang from the great head of the [body]. A single root is the root of them all, because they all hang from the great head that is on top of the body. Should a limb be cut from the tip of [the]se small [h]eads, the great head that is on top of them [al]l stays in its place the way that it is [and] you find this person alive. Al[l] these sm[all h]eads are firmly set in it [the great head]

Wh[en] they will cut from them [the little heads,] all of them, these little [heads] shall [become dead like] the corpses, because they might see [no power, because they no longer] be firmly set [to] in the body, which they joined wi[th it,]
In exactly this way, it is also the case that the storehouses of darkness are the same, the things from which the [darkness gushed] forth.

changes_summary: Applied Finding 2 (¶2) excision: removed the clause “that he might construct from them this universe and fashion everything appropriate for the greatness.” Minimal punctuation adjustment made so the paragraph remains coherent after the excision. No other changes per Findings 1, 3, and 4 (recommendation: none).
